The '''Lady Fate''' was a [[Casino/Legends|casino]] located along the Path of Coins in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. During the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the bartender at the Lady Fate was a [[Codru-Ji]].
